sky.qualification: Albiorix's sky orientation for its camera; the shared universe draws the visible sky.

provenance.qualification: Computed Albiorix Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.
